purpose: Deploy Pterodactyl panel/Wings and manage the repository's node import and egg workflows.
notes: Distinguish panel installation, Wings installation and existing-node import. Read scripts/install_pterodactyl.sh, scripts/install_wings.sh or scripts/import_node.sh for the requested operation. Preserve existing database, node credentials and game data.
purpose_zh: 部署 Pterodactyl 面板和 Wings，处理节点导入及 Egg 工作流。
notes_zh: 区分面板安装、Wings 安装和导入现有节点，分别核对 scripts/install_pterodactyl.sh、scripts/install_wings.sh、scripts/import_node.sh。保留已有数据库、节点凭据和游戏数据。
